instruction: An intimate, professional studio portrait captured in a close-up shot from a slightly high angle against a solid, warm beige background. On the left, the dark-haired woman in the white ruffled top (R1) leans forward from behind, resting her right hand gently on the right shoulder of her companion while gazing directly at the camera with a soft, gentle expression. In the foreground, the woman wearing a light satin headscarf and a beige ruffled top (R2) sits with her head tilted slightly, leaning back against her companion and looking at the camera with a warm, subtle smile and dark red lipstick. The two women pose with their heads close together, illuminated by warm, soft studio lighting that creates a gentle, intimate atmosphere with soft shadows and a warm color palette.
elements: R1 leans forward from behind R2 and places her right hand on R2's right shoulder
R2 sits in the foreground and leans back against R1
R1 is the rear companion making shoulder contact while R2 is the seated foreground companion receiving that contact
the two women keep their heads close together in a close-up studio portrait
the portrait is set against a solid warm beige studio background
